description: Leidos Holdings, Inc., a Delaware corporation, is a holding company whose direct 100 percent owned subsidiary and principal operating company is Leidos, Inc., which was founded in 1969 by physicist Dr. Robert Beyster and has since applied its expertise in science, research and engineering in rapidly evolving technologies and markets to solve complex problems of global concern. Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations, and is headquartered in Reston, Virginia with 47,000 global employees, pursuing strategic growth across five pillars: space and maritime, energy infrastructure, digital modernization and cyber, mission software, and managed health services, with customers including the U.S. Department of War, the U.S. Intelligence Community and other U.S. government agencies as well as commercial customers.
